Assalaamu alaikum wa rahmatullah, Dear Sheikh, I pray to Allah SWT that you are enjoying a good health & high Islamic spirit. (1) It has come to my knowledge that some people observe certain nawwafil salaah by reciting any specific surah a certain number of times( that is more than once) in each raka'ah after reading surah faati'ha. Sometimes they would make an extra sajdah after reading the tashahhud & darood and there, they would ask for any specific doah they are in need for. They would even call this salah as haajaat. However I have not cross of any of this kind of salaah in the ahadeeth. Could you please enlighten me on this. (2) My second question is about those 'aamil who after asking someone's name & mother's name, claim that they make istikhaarah salah in order to find out if that person is under the influence of jiin or evil eyes etc. As far as i understand, Istikhaarah salaah is accomplished when someone is unsure of whether doing something is good for him/her or not. But what I don't understand is how Istikhaarah salaah can help someone to find out the malady of someone else. Would that not be more appropriate to offer haajah salaah in this context? I look forward to your valuable views and comments on the above two issues Incha Allah. I thank you in anticipation for your cooperation. Wassalaam. 2469 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 45158 Country: United States of America Title: Dua for Meiner Disease Question: My sister has been diagnosed with menieres disease. It is a disorder of the inner ear that causes severe dizziness (vertigo), ringing in the ears (tinnitus), hearing loss, and a feeling of fullness or congestion in the ear. She gets sudden attacks of dizziness after a short period of tinnitus or muffled hearing. She gets extreme vertigo and severe vomiting. After each attacks, she feels very weak and tired. Doctors said there is no cure for this disease. I would like to request you to please pray for her that Allah (SWT) give her complete shifa. And could you please show us some dua or wazifah to help her condition? Answer ID: 45158 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 788/634/B=1434) We pray for your sister that Allah give her shifa. One dua is mentioned in hadith, recite it seven times and blow on you. The dua is as follows: أسأل الله العظيم رب العرض العظيم أن يشفينى. Also recite يا سلام يا سلام extensively. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
